title: Pickaxes
content:
# Pickaxes

# Introduction

Pickaxes are a weapon class.
They can be used to mine ores, which no other type of player-weapon can do. Pickaxes formerly only hit a single target, but as of the Hearth and Home update, gained a cleaving attribute.
Their primary attack is a downward swing. They do not have a secondary attack.

## List of pickaxes

• Name: Antler pickaxe | Damage (Min/Max): Pickaxe/Pierce: 18 | Stamina: 6 | Mineable Ore Deposit: Stone, Copper, Tin, Muddy scrap pile, Abyssal barnacle

• Name: Bronze pickaxe | Damage (Min/Max): Pierce: 25/40 Pickaxe: 25/37 | Stamina: 8 | Mineable Ore Deposit: Stone, Copper, Tin, Muddy scrap pile, Abyssal barnacle

• Name: Iron pickaxe | Damage (Min/Max): Pickaxe/Pierce: 33/48 | Stamina: 10 | Mineable Ore Deposit: Stone, Copper, Tin, Muddy scrap pile, Abyssal barnacle, Obsidian, Silver

• Name: Black metal pickaxe | Damage (Min/Max): Pickaxe/Pierce: 49/64 | Stamina: 14 | Mineable Ore Deposit: Stone, Copper, Tin, Muddy scrap pile, Abyssal barnacle, Obsidian, Silver, Black marble, Soft tissue, Flametal ore vein

## Properties

• Attack type: Pickaxe (primary) | Stamina (base): 6–14 | Range: 1.8m | Attack speed: 1.4 s | Damage: 1x | Staggering: 1x | Knockback: 50 | Notes: 20 degree arc.

## Tips

• The simplest way to get your first pickaxe is to defeat the first boss to obtain the antler pickaxe.
